tools.name: catalog___search_content
tools.description: Find titles to schedule. Filters combine with AND; genres and ratings match any listed value. Results are paged with next_token.

inputSchema.description: Catalog search: free text plus genre/rating filters; all criteria are combined with AND.

text.description: Words to match in title or synopsis.

correlation_id.description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

tools.name: library___find_assets
tools.description: List library assets matching every given filter (kind, status, ladder_version, content_id), one compact row each, paged with next_token. Use it to find READY content encoded with a channel's ladder version before planning, or to see what is still ingesting; library___get_asset has the full asset.

kind.description: content = schedulable programs, slate = break and filler slates, ad = house-ad creatives (one of content, slate, ad).

status.description: READY assets can be scheduled; INGESTING and ENCODED are still in the pipeline (one of INGESTING, ENCODED, READY, FAILED).

ladder_version.description: Only encodes with this ladder version; a channel airs only assets of its own ladder (pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*@[0-9a-f]{10}$).

content_id.description: Only encodes of this catalog title (max length 64).

limit.description: Maximum number of assets to return (default 50; ≥ 1; ≤ 100).

next_token.description: next_token from the previous page; omit for the first page.

correlation_id.description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

tools.name: schedule___get_schedule
tools.description: Get a channel's published schedule from now on: programs with UTC start/end, title, rating and ad breaks, the end of the schedule (end; schedule___plan appends there by default) and the filler gaps between programs.

tools.name: schedule___plan
tools.description: Plan a block of programs on a channel; nothing changes on air. The picks air back to back in the given order from start, right after the program named in after, or by default where the published schedule ends (10 minutes from now when it is empty). Computes every start time, on-air duration (content plus ad breaks), ad break and SCTE-35 id, and checks the brief (ratings, genres, dayparts) and the schedule (overlaps, lead time). Returns a plan_id with the program table in UTC, the violations and publishable. Error violations block publishing: change the picks or the start and plan again; warnings are for the operator to accept. Publish with schedule___publish within the hour.

channel.description: Channel name from channels___list_channels (min length 1; max length 64).

picks.description: Asset ids in air order: READY content encoded with the channel's ladder version (library___find_assets). An id listed twice airs twice (min items 1; max items 100).

start.description: UTC ISO-8601 start of the block, e.g. 2026-10-16T18:00:00Z. Omit start and after to append to the published schedule (format date-time).

after.description: Name of an upcoming program, from schedule___get_schedule, that the block starts right after.

break_policy.description: Ad-break policy for this block only; omit to use the channel brief's.

cadence_minutes.description: Target minutes from the end of one ad break to the next, counted across programs (default 12; > 0).

min_gap_minutes.description: Minimum minutes between the end of one break and the next break (default 6; ≥ 0).

max_breaks.description: Most breaks per program; omit for no limit (≥ 0).

slate_gops.description: Break length in GOPs, one of 15, 30, 45, 60: about 30, 60, 90 or 120 s with 2 s GOPs (default 30).

correlation_id.description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.

tools.name: schedule___publish
tools.description: Publish a plan to the channel's live schedule; this changes what airs. Takes only the plan_id of a publishable plan from schedule___plan (plans expire after an hour). Fails with PLAN_STALE when the schedule changed since planning: call schedule___get_schedule and plan again. Returns the published programs as guide entries and the channel's alerts. Requires operator approval: calling it asks the operator, and it runs once they approve. Call it rather than asking for approval in text.

plan_id.description: plan_id returned by schedule___plan in this conversation (min length 3).

correlation_id.description: Correlation id for tracing. Set automatically by the agent runtime; never invent one.
